description: Inviting speakers and organising seminars on various topics in geophysics for the Earth Sciences Department at University College London (UCL).
Organiser of a mini symposium at the 17th US National Congress on Computational Mechanics.
I have reviewed proposals submitted to the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) in the areas of Rock Mechanics, Engineering and Modelling.

organisation: Imperial Postdocs and Fellows Enterprise Network
description: Supporting researchers in establishing their start-ups and consultancy work to commercialise their research at Imperial College London.

role: Member of the Rapid Assistance in Modelling the Pandemic
description: I was a member of the Royal Society's RAMP committee (Rapid Assistance in Modelling the COVID Pandemic) that provides the UK government with scientific advice during the COVID-19 pandemic.

role: College Representative of Postdocs and Fellows
description: College representative of postdocs and fellows of the Earth Science and Engineering Department. In this role, I liaise between postdocs/fellows and department leadership to improve the working environment and research culture for early career researchers. I was awarded a certificate of appreciation from the Head of Department for my work that went above and beyond expectations.

organisation: European Community on Computational Methods in Applied Sciences and Engineering (ECCOMAS)
description: Organiser of a mini symposia at the World Congress in Computational Mechanics and European Congress on Computational Methods in Applied Sciences and Engineering.

I have reviewed manuscripts for the following journals: Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering, Engineering Computations, Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering, Bulletin of Engineering Geology and the Environment, International Journal of Pavement Engineering, Powder Technology, Granular Matter, Journal of Visualized Experiments

organisation: Hermes Summer School on Multiscale Modelling of Materials
description: Organising committee member for an international materials-modelling summer school at Cumberland Lodge. Planned classes and activities, reviewed current methods and trends, coordinated world-class academic and industry speakers, and liaised with funders. Led partnerships with companies and charities to promote the event and secure funding, and during the school I led working groups and supervised activities.
